stem: Over many shots, which outcomes appear (bit order `c1 c0`)?
code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

qr = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
cr = ClassicalRegister(2, 'c')
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
qc.sx(2)
qc.measure(2, 1)
with qc.if_test((cr[1], 1)):
    qc.x(0)
qc.measure(0, 0)

options.text: `00` and `11`, but `11` in roughly a quarter of the shots.

explanation.correct: √X on `|0⟩` gives an equal superposition, so measuring qubit 2 into `c1` yields 0 or 1 with ~50% each. The `if_test` flips qubit 0 exactly when `c1`=1, and qubit 0 is then measured into `c0`, so `c0` always equals `c1`: only `00` and `11` appear.

distractors.A: This leaves `c0` at 0 on every shot, as if the `if_test` body never ran because the bit was still 0 while the circuit was being built. The condition is evaluated on each shot at run time, so the X fires whenever `c1`=1.
distractors.B: Qubit 0 is not independent: it is flipped exactly when `c1`=1, so the two bits are correlated and only two of the four combinations occur.
distractors.C: √X is half an X: on `|0⟩` it makes an equal superposition, not `|1⟩`. It takes two √X gates to flip the qubit, so `c1` is 0 on about half the shots.
distractors.E: This is what you would see if the X ran when `c1`=0. The condition `(cr[1], 1)` fires on the value 1, so the two bits agree rather than differ.
distractors.F: The right pair of outcomes with the wrong weights: `c1` is 1 on about half the shots and the X fires on every one of them, so `11` is ~50%, not ~25%.

verification.proof_script:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

# verbatim stem code
qr = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
cr = ClassicalRegister(2, 'c')
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
qc.sx(2)
qc.measure(2, 1)
with qc.if_test((cr[1], 1)):
    qc.x(0)
qc.measure(0, 0)

sim = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=42)
counts = sim.run(qc, shots=4000).result().get_counts()
total = sum(counts.values())
seen = set(counts)

def near(bs, frac, tol=0.06):
    return abs(counts.get(bs, 0)/total - frac) <= tol

claims = {
    "A": seen == {"00", "10"},
    "B": seen == {"00", "01", "10", "11"},
    "C": seen == {"11"},
    "D": seen == {"00", "11"} and near("00", 0.5) and near("11", 0.5),
    "E": seen == {"01", "10"},
    "F": seen == {"00", "11"} and near("11", 0.25),
}
evidence = {
    "A": f"observed outcomes={dict(counts)}; claim {{00,10}} (body never fires) -> {claims['A']}",
    "B": f"observed outcomes={dict(counts)}; claim all four -> {claims['B']}",
    "C": f"observed outcomes={dict(counts)}; claim only 11 (sx read as a full X) -> {claims['C']}",
    "D": f"observed outcomes={dict(counts)}; only {{00,11}} ~50/50 -> {claims['D']}",
    "E": f"observed outcomes={dict(counts)}; claim {{01,10}} -> {claims['E']}",
    "F": (f"observed outcomes={dict(counts)}; the 11 share is {counts.get('11', 0)/total:.2f}, "
          f"not a quarter -> {claims['F']}"),
}
proven = [k for k, v in claims.items() if v]
emit_verdict({"answer": proven, "evidence": evidence, "observed": {"counts": dict(counts)}})
